general.description: What the quote agent has been doing

list.emptyStateSubline: The agent serviced no quote matching this period and outcome.
list.deleteBody: This removes all {count} recorded passes for quote #{quoteNumber}. Audit rows cannot be rebuilt.
list.truncated: Showing the {shown} most recently serviced quotes of {total} passes in this period. Narrow the period to see all of them.

figures.title: This period

figures.noBaseline: no comparable deals in this period

detail.missingSubline: This record could not be loaded. It may have been deleted.
detail.historySubtitle: What the customer asked, what the agent did about it, and why — in the order it happened.

terminalWhy.accepted: The customer accepted this quote, and their order exists.
terminalWhy.declined: The customer turned the offer down.
terminalWhy.expired: The quote passed its validity date without being ordered.
terminalWhy.cancelled: The quote was cancelled before it was ordered.
terminalWhy.withdrawn: The offer was withdrawn before the customer acted on it.

access.identityLinkingHelp: Lets buyer agents obtain a customer token for this sales channel. Without it, sign-in fails with a misleading “authorization link expired” page.
access.platformAllowlistHelp: Hosts allowed to act as an agent platform when identity linking is used.
access.remoteProfileAllowlistHelp: Hosts whose agent profile this shop may fetch. Profiles are fetched over HTTPS only.
access.agentAllowlistHelp: Domains whose agents may transact with this sales channel.
access.forbidden: Saving needs the Agentic Commerce ucp.editor privilege.
access.effectiveNote: Derived from the fields above and this sales channel’s domain, following the Agentic Commerce fallback rule. An empty list is not a deny-all — it narrows access to the fallback host.
access.noDomain: This sales channel has no domain

escalationWhy.anUnstatedAmount: an amount it could not read as a percentage
escalationWhy.discount_limit_exceeded: The customer asked for {asked}, which is more than your {cap} maximum discount. Granting more than the cap is a decision only a person can make.
escalationWhy.quote_value_limit_exceeded: This quote is worth {value}, above the maximum quote value you set for negotiation. Large quotes are handed over whatever the discount asked for.
escalationWhy.currency_mismatch: No maximum quote value is configured for {currency}, so the agent cannot tell whether this quote is inside your ceiling. Set one for that currency to let it negotiate.
escalationWhy.needs_human_review: The customer asked for a person, or asked for something outside price and validity — a delivery term, a payment term, or a change to what is being sold. The agent can only negotiate price.
escalationWhy.not_configured: The agent is switched on but its configuration is incomplete or invalid, so it answered nothing rather than guess. The technical details below name the fields.
escalationWhy.model_unavailable: The model could not be reached, or answered with something unusable. Nothing was written to the quote.
escalationWhy.proposal_rejected: The model proposed terms outside the authority your policies allow, so the policy layer refused them. The quote was left untouched.
escalationWhy.verification_failed: The quote was changed, but re-reading it did not match what had been authorised, so it needs a person to confirm before the customer is told anything.

write.updateLineItems: Set new unit prices on the requested lines
write.updateQuote: Applied the discount and a new validity date

note.attemptRetried: An earlier attempt on this quote crashed before it finished ({count} so far). This pass started over.
note.nothingToDo: There was nothing to answer: no new customer request the agent could read, and no open price target on any line. The quote was left untouched.
note.notAuthorized: The agent proposed terms your policies do not allow, so nothing was authorised and the quote was left untouched.
note.notVerified: The quote was changed, but re-reading it afterwards did not match what had been authorised.
note.needsAttention: This pass reported success but did not finish cleanly. Check the quote before relying on it.
